base_shift_probe.note: the same code sits at the same file offset in a sibling image but under a 0x08010000 load address, which is why alt-base agreement exists at all

method.classification: exact_primary / partial_primary / exact_alt_base / partial_alt_base / foreign, by agreement at 0x08008000 versus 0x08010000
method.consequence: only exact_primary files may contribute entry points without further validation; partial_primary entries are trial-decoded before use; foreign files are excluded entirely
method.rule: an export row is corroborated when its serialised bytes equal the frozen bytes at the same address; a 32-bit row stores its second halfword as a halfword value and is normalised before comparison
